note: Written by hand rather than by scripts/uc_source.py: the page carried no references at all when this entry began, so the harvester had nothing to resolve. All four references below were found by forward search and added to the page by this entry.

citations.title: Randomized Half-Ideal Cipher on Groups with applications to UC (a)PAKE

also_printed.what: the t^2-correlations argument that plain 2-Feistel does not realize F_HIC

citations.paging: PDF page and printed folio agree throughout.

citations.title: C'est tres CHIC: A compact password-authenticated key exchange from lattice-based KEM
citations.finding: Prints no HIC functionality; uses m2F as a white-box drop-in and proves CHIC directly in the RO and IC models. Its section 2 gives the F_HIC+ counterexample showing the honest-interface restriction is necessary.

citations.title: HIC Is All You Need: Practical Post-Quantum Password-Authenticated Public-Key Encryption
citations.finding: A restatement of the 2023/295 box, labelled 'from [33]', threading sid explicitly through a list rather than keying a table by password. Checked line by line: no change of content, so it does not supersede the definition taken.

citations.authors: Bradley, Camenisch, Jarecki, Lehmann, Neven, Xu
citations.title: Password-Authenticated Public-Key Encryption
citations.finding: Establishes the negative fact in the page's lead: proves in the F_IC-hybrid model and declines to print F_IC, saying on p. 39 that it will 'for the ease of exposition use the algorithm-based' form. Prints F_PAPKE (Fig. 1), F_PKE (Fig. 9) and F_PAKE (Fig. 10), none of which belongs to this page.
